name: ElevenLabs Voice
description: Official ElevenLabs AI voice & speech synthesis plugin. Generates realistic MP3 audio ready to download and share in chat.
author: Chattree Core Team
changelog: 1.0.2: Resolved static memory overlap in WAT, added robust HTTP status checking, expanded memory to 256 pages (16MB), and switched default voice to George (JBFqnCBsd6RMkjVDRZzb) for universal free/paid tier support.

tools.description: Genera un audio realista en MP3 a partir de texto usando la API de ElevenLabs. Invoca con /elevenlabs <texto> o /tts <texto>.
